objective: Deployed-app verification plus source-grounded inventory of the two outstanding separate physical Objects, without contacting anyone or copying external theatre photographs.

site.limits: Live browser check invokes actual shipped popup with deployed Place JSON; not a user gesture through map or physical phone.

candidates.physical_object: 1989 Madame de Sade costume held by Oslo Museum
candidates.note: One verified physical object; photographic proof and public source display do not alone fulfill the two-member Objects collection.

candidates.physical_object: Hulda Garborg's own bunad publicly described as displayed in Det Norske Teatret foyer

independent_support.finding: Theatre text states that one of Hulda's own bunads is on display in the foyer; historic photograph is of Hulda wearing a bunad, not a catalogued separate photograph of the currently exhibited artifact.
Bunad maker reports having visited the original on display and using it as a reference for a modern reconstruction.

candidates.exclusion: Public-domain 200×256 portrait of Hulda in a bunad is not demonstrated to depict the separately identifiable foyer artifact: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Hulda_Garborg-bunad.jpg
candidates.needs: Photo documenting the exact foyer artifact and a stable object identity, not a generic portrait or reconstructed commercial bunad.

candidates.physical_object: Unni Walstad-designed Juleroser stage dress, with reused embroidery from a disassembled Hulda-inspired garment, made in the theatre costume department

primary_support.finding: Article identifies designer and costume-department work and captions the dress fitting photo with photographer Ole Herman Andersen.

contextual_support.finding: 2026 programme confirms Juleroser on Hovudscenen but does not prove which exact dated garment is worn in 2026.

candidates.needs: Exact physical garment identity, date and approved distributable member image if later added to canonical Objects; public original-source link alone is not a licensed local member image.

constraints: No permissions request or email shall be sent; C39 draft is archived and unsent.
No invented museum ownership/accession for bunad or Juleroser dress.
Never represent the portrait as a photograph of an independently identified foyer exhibit.
Keep historical 1985-house boundary: exclude costumes predating the building without concrete site linkage.
Do not publish Objects, member images, or claim Place complete until canonical Object contract is satisfied.
